description: Creates a trip plan for a trip through Seattle-Tacoma Airport (SEA) or Seattle: rides, hotel, flights, a cruise from Seattle, tours and events in one plan, timed so it fits. Give the arrival date (or a cruise sailing), travelers, and anything already known; you can add the rest later with add_to_plan. Creates a stored plan and returns plan_id, edit_key (keep private; needed to change it), plan_url (the visual, shareable plan page: show this to the traveler), summary_markdown, what's still needed, warnings, and hotel_options. The rides between the airport, hotel, pier and stops are planned automatically. Nothing is booked or charged: the traveler books from plan_url.

arrival_flight.description: flight: arriving flight number, e.g. AS 23, only once booked (the plan then shows the flight in as booked). Before that give landing_time, or search_flights.

cruise_sail_date.description: The sailing date in Seattle, YYYY-MM-DD.

cruise_ship.description: A cruise from Seattle: the ship (from find_cruise_sailings).

departure_time.description: flight: flight home's departure, Seattle time HH:MM.

end.description: The day they leave (no cruise), YYYY-MM-DD. Or give nights.

event_id.description: A trip built around one game, concert or show: its pick_id (ev-<slug>) from find_events_near. Give event_date too; it sets the dates (start defaults to that day) and purpose event, and puts the event on its day.

home_airport.description: flight: 3-letter code they fly from, e.g. ORD.

hotel_name.description: hotel: or a hotel booked elsewhere, "name, address".

hotel_slug.description: One of our hotels (slug from hotel_options of an earlier answer, or recommend_hotels_with_rides).

items.description: More to put on the plan right away (up to 12), each like add_to_plan's item, e.g. {"type":"tour","id":"space-needle","date":"2027-05-05"}.

address.description: meeting: where it is (a business address).

already_booked.description: hotel, flight, cruise, tour: the traveler already booked it (shown as booked).

arrival_flight.description: flight: arriving flight number, e.g. AS 23, only once booked (the plan then shows the flight in as booked). Before that give landing_time, or search_flights.

date.description: The day (YYYY-MM-DD), a day in Seattle on the plan. Needed for tours, restaurants, events, meetings; optional for parking and rental_car.

departure_time.description: flight: flight home's departure, Seattle time HH:MM.

home_airport.description: flight: 3-letter code they fly from, e.g. ORD.

hotel_name.description: hotel: or a hotel booked elsewhere, "name, address".

hotel_slug.description: hotel: one of hotel_options (bookable on seatac.co).

id.description: tour/experience: pick_id from find_things_to_do (e.g. space-needle). restaurant: pick_id from find_restaurants (eat-...). event: ev-<slug> from find_events_near.

landing_time.description: flight: landing at SEA, Seattle time HH:MM.

name.description: meeting: a short label, e.g. Client meeting. No personal details.

part.description: Part of the day: morning, lunch, afternoon, dinner or evening (default: when it usually fits).

sail_date.description: cruise: embarkation date in Seattle, YYYY-MM-DD.

kids.description: How many of them are kids (default 0).

landing_time.description: flight: landing at SEA, Seattle time HH:MM.

local.description: They live in the Seattle area: no flight or hotel; the plan offers the ride there and back (by licensed partners) or parking. With an event and no end, a same-day plan.

nights.description: Nights in Seattle instead of end (0-21, default 2). With a cruise the Seattle nights run to sailing day.

purpose.description: vacation (default), business, visit, event or other.

start.description: The day they arrive in Seattle, YYYY-MM-DD. Optional with a cruise (default: the day before sailing).

name: plan_trip

name.description: The plan's name, e.g. "Alaska cruise · May 7–14": use it when the traveler has more than one plan.

plan_url.description: The visual plan page for the traveler. Share this link.

summary_markdown.description: A short day-by-day summary to show in the chat.

title: Plan a SEA / Seattle trip
